section.20: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day

20.name_native: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Aishah that:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not pray at night because he was prevented from doing so by sleep- meaning, sleep overwhelmed him- or by pain, he would pray twelve rak'ahs during the day
